purpose: Route vendor and acquisition communications to the smallest appropriate contact role using ontology-style intent and lifecycle context.

publicRepositoryBoundary.contactResolution: Resolve addresses at runtime from a current authorized directory, opportunity record, or private configuration.
publicRepositoryBoundary.sensitiveMaterial: Do not place classified, CUI, procurement-sensitive, credential, or private-vault material into outbound low-side communications.

routingPrinciples: Opportunity-specific questions route to the named opportunity POC before broad outreach channels.
Use the narrowest role that matches the communication intent.
Do not mass-mail every available contact with the same message.
Preserve source provenance for every resolved address and role.
Pricing, terms acceptance, legal commitments, certifications, and representations require authorized human/business approval.
Outbound content must remain appropriate for the destination channel and handling level.
A directory entry provides a communication path; it does not create external authorization, award status, clearance, or affiliation.

contactRoles.scope: future digital and software capability engagement
